guide.overview:
Etihad Town Phase 1 is a gated housing society on Main Raiwind Road, Lahore, a short way south of Thokar Niaz Baig. Its 150 ft Main Boulevard starts at Raiwind Road and runs through the society, crossed by an 80 ft avenue at a roundabout.

Layout

Commercial plots line the boulevard and Raiwind Road. Next to the entrance is the large central park with a public building, and in the middle of the society are the mosque, school and clinic. The residential streets of 5 and 10 marla plots fill most of the plan, with 12 and 18 marla and 1 and 2 kanal plots in the outer pockets.

Approval

The scheme is approved by the Lahore Development Authority (NOC LDA/DMP-I/1683). The LDA has also warned buyers about plots sold outside the approved area, so check a plot's position and status with the LDA before you buy.

Buying in Etihad Town

Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.
